Course · Brazilian Portuguese for English speakers

Learn Brazilian Portuguese from first words to C1.

A complete course in the Portuguese of Brazil, written for English speakers: 76 modules in eight tiers, with the grammar explained directly, over 5,000 exercises with feedback that gives the reason, and every Portuguese word open to tap for its meaning, forms and audio.

Start learning free

The whole course is free, with the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test. Specializations, conversation practice, stories, the Celpe-Bras papers and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

The course in eight tiers

  1. Tier 1 · Sounds and first wordsPronunciation and spelling, greetings, articles, ser, numbers.
  2. Tier 2 · Everyday basics-ar, -er and -ir verbs, ter and gostar, questions, family, time.
  3. Tier 3 · Daily lifeIrregular verbs, ser, estar and ficar, contractions, food, the city.
  4. Tier 4 · The pastThe preterite and the imperfect, object pronouns, travel, health.
  5. Tier 5 · Building fluencyPronoun placement, the future, the conditional, the imperative, work.
  6. Tier 6 · IntermediateThe present subjunctive, the pluperfect, reported speech.
  7. Tier 7 · Upper intermediateThe future subjunctive, the personal infinitive, the passive, society.
  8. Tier 8 · AdvancedCompound subjunctive tenses, style, spoken and regional Portuguese.

5 to 12 modules per tier. The placement test lets you start further up.

The course

What the course teaches, and how

  • 1

    One variety, consistently

    The course teaches the Portuguese of Brazil: você, Brazilian spelling, vocabulary and pronunciation throughout. European Portuguese and regional variation have a module of their own in Tier 8.

  • 2

    Grammar explained directly

    Each grammar module states the rule, with examples, before you practise it: ser, estar and ficar, where the object pronoun goes, the future subjunctive and the personal infinitive, which English does not have.

  • 3

    Feedback that says why

    Every answer is graded with a reason and a link to the rule in the grammar reference, so a wrong ending tells you which form was needed and why.

  • 4

    Reading, listening, writing and speaking

    Exercises include translation, cloze, dictation, listening, form tables and readings, and speaking exercises with pronunciation feedback.

  • 5

    Every word inspectable

    Tap any Portuguese word in an exercise, reading or explanation for its meaning, its forms and its audio.

  • 6

    Brazil in the topics

    Topic modules cover food, the city, work, the media, politics and society, history, literature, law and humour, with spoken Brazilian Portuguese taught in a module of its own.

Exam preparation

Practice papers for Celpe-Bras

The course has timed practice papers for one exam:

  • Celpe-Bras, Brazil's certificate of proficiency in Portuguese: four practice papers for its written part, with original content. The oral part is not included.

Questions

Common questions

Is this Brazilian or European Portuguese?
Brazilian. The vocabulary, spelling and audio follow Brazilian norms throughout. One Tier 8 module covers how European Portuguese and the regions of Brazil differ.
Is the course really free?
Yes. All 76 modules from A1 to C1, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free. Premium adds specializations, conversation practice, stories, the Celpe-Bras papers and the other extras.
I already know some Portuguese. Do I have to start at the beginning?
No. The placement test finds the tier that fits and starts you there.
Can I practise speaking?
Yes. The course has speaking exercises with pronunciation feedback. Premium adds conversation practice with an AI character and pronunciation practice on any sentence you type.
I speak Spanish. Is there a course for me?
Yes. Brazilian Portuguese for Spanish speakers is a shorter course of 40 modules, explained in Spanish and built around what differs from Spanish.
